name: hakeemify/debloater-pro
description: Workflow features for people who manage several WordPress sites with Debloater. A separate plugin, extending the free one only through hooks it documents.

comment: The free plugin is not a Composer dependency, and deliberately not one.
Pro extends it through hooks Debloater documents rather than by calling
into its classes, so a version constraint here would assert a coupling
that does not exist. The integration tests do need it present, and get
it as a checkout beside this one -- see README.md.
